targets.query: SELECT "run_number" FROM "dunedaq.drunc.opmon.RunInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND $timeFilter AND run_number>0

SELECT mean("rate_payloads_consumed")*1000 FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.DataHandlerInfo" WHERE "session" = '${session}' AND "application"=~ /${application}/ AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element"

SELECT mean("num_buffer_elements") FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.LatencyBufferInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "application"=~ /${application}/ AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element" fill(null)

SELECT sum("data") FROM ( SELECT mean("num_buffer_elements") AS "data" FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.LatencyBufferInfo" WHERE  "session"='${session}' AND "application"=~ /${application}/ AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "element" fill(null) ) GROUP BY time($__interval)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(cumulative_sum(sum("num_buffer_cleanups")), 1s) FROM "dunedaq.datahandlinglibs.opmon.RequestHandlerInfo" WHERE "session"='${session}' AND "application"=~ /${application}/ AND "element" =~ /^${DLH}$/  AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
